name: splitpage-desktop
description: Splitpage as a standalone desktop app — own window, native menus and file associations, the same document server underneath for LAN sharing.
author: RetroGorilla

scripts.dist:win: node stage.mjs && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --win --x64 --arm64 && node verify-dist.mjs --arch both
